Pistons @ Heat 6/10 7:00 - Giannis probable, Duren out, B2B Heat
Mavericks @ Cavaliers 5/10 6:30 - Mobley out, Cavs on a back-to-back
Nets @ Grizzlies 4/10 7:00 - Edey questionable, rookies in a close spread

games.notes: Duren out for Detroit; Giannis probable for Miami, Klay probable. Cade's Pistons are the better team, but Heat are on a back-to-back and at home, so it should be competitive.
Mobley out, Mitchell, Harden and Allen questionable for Cleveland; Lively out for Dallas. Flagg and the young Mavs against a tired Cavs team on a back-to-back, watchable if Mitchell plays.
Edey and Grant questionable, Ty Jerome out for Memphis, who are on a back-to-back. Nets rookies Mikel Brown Jr. and Nolan Traore are probable; a thin game but could stay close.
Edwards and DiVincenzo out for Minnesota; Claxton and Powell questionable for Chicago. Bulls are bad enough that Minnesota should still win comfortably, likely blowout.
Strawther out for Denver; Trey Murphy and Dejounte Murray out for New Orleans. Mid Nuggets against a gutted Pelicans team on a back-to-back, likely blowout and skippable.
